note: Every acceptance criterion, NFR9.x and BRx.y for this Unit, mapped to the file that implements or enforces it. Targets are workspace-relative paths so the mapping is checkable mechanically; the `rationale` field carries what the path alone does not say. Deferred rows are decisions, not gaps: the formatting operation and its three NFRs were deferred out of B1 by human decision at this stage's entry (OQ-B1-1 unanswered, B1's DoD amended to match); AC5.2.2 and NFR9.10 need persistence, which a library Unit does not have. Each names where it lands.

coverage.rationale: Carry-forward and the derived ledger quantities: the eight worked scenarios plus the three-period carry, all asserting the identity

Correction history is a property of persisted entries and their supersession. This Unit persists nothing; it lands with the Unit that owns the ledger table. Marked Deferred at Functional Design and unchanged here
Construction from a binary float raises, checked on the TYPE so an integral float is refused identically
Ruff rule sets ban the float-literal decimal construction; the variable-valued case falls through to NFR9.1
No __float__ and no __int__ defined; absence is the mechanism
Gate 1: walks the money package's own imports and fails on any edge into api/db/repositories/authz/schemas
Gate 2: flake8-tidy-imports banned-api on decimal, with app/money/** re-permitted by explicit exception
Committed violation fixtures for both gates, each asserted to fail, running in CI on every push
Kotlin value class plus the package-wide float ban, verified by adding a toDouble() escape hatch and observing the failure
One chokepoint emitting the canonical JSON string; never a JSON number
Client rejects a JSON number loudly, asserted both directions. Verified against a deliberately lenient decoder

The storage chokepoint (TypeDecorator to NUMERIC(12,2)) needs a model and a table, neither of which a library Unit has. Lands with the Unit that owns the first migration; its column assertion is now on that Bolt's DoD
Serializing a negative raises; the canonical pattern admits no sign
Property-based test over 2000 randomized well-formed histories, generators derived from the kind enumeration
100% branch coverage on app/money, build-gated, with one named configuration exclusion and no inline pragmas
Named-test manifest: 30 entries, each stating its acceptance criterion and the rule it enforces
Where an operation admits more than one answer satisfying its own property test, the design fixes it: test_negative_magnitude_then_sign asserts the specific parts in order
Runtime dependency surface is empty: the money module imports only decimal and its own siblings
Admission note per new dependency. No runtime dependency was added by this Unit, so the obligation is recorded rather than exercised
Secrets scan blocks every push with no severity threshold; dependency CVEs annotate per-push and block at the release gate
Closure by the ABSENCE of a default: a total match with no else arm, so an unrecognised kind cannot pass through
Generators derive their kind set from the enumeration, so a kind added later appears in histories automatically
test_every_kind_has_a_handwritten_expectation fails immediately when a kind is added without naming its effect
The per-locale rendering specification. Deferred with the formatting operation by human decision; OQ-B1-1 is unanswered
Exact-output test per locale. Nothing to assert until the rendering specification exists
Bangla rendering asserted to differ from the canonical Latin form. Deferred with the operation it checks
EXPECTED_EFFECT is hand-written per kind, independent of the IDENTITY_SIDE map the fold reads. Verified: mis-siding a kind was caught by the worked scenario, not by the type checker
app/money/_money.py __init__ refuses float and bool by TYPE; tests/money/test_construction.py TestFloatRefusal (4 tests incl. the integral-float case)
app/money/_money.py accepts Decimal, int, str only; malformed input raises. tests/money/test_construction.py TestAcceptedInputs
app/money/_rounding.py EXPONENT; quantize at construction. tests/money/test_construction.py TestQuantization, incl. equal-values-hash-equally
app/money/_money.py module docstring and type: BDT implicit, no currency attribute anywhere
frozen slots dataclass; tests/money/test_construction.py test_immutable
No __float__/__int__ defined. tests/money/test_construction.py test_no_float_conversion, test_no_int_conversion
app/money/_rounding.py MAGNITUDE_LIMIT; refused not truncated. tests/money/test_construction.py TestOverflow incl. the negative case
app/money/_errors.py MoneyValidationError, the only class, with the structural argument for why three taxonomy classes are unreachable here
__add__/__sub__ return NotImplemented for non-Money. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py TestAddSubtract
apply_rate is a named method; no __mul__ exists. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py TestApplyRate
allocate distributes the remainder across leading parts. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py test_exact_sum_positive, all four tabled rows
Money.ZERO as a ClassVar. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py test_zero_constant
Money.sum with a zero identity. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py test_sum_empty_is_zero
is_zero/is_positive/is_negative and four type-safe comparisons. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py TestComparison, tests/money/test_uncovered_paths.py TestComparisonWithNonMoney
Negatives permitted by the type, constrained per context. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py test_subtract_can_go_negative
allocate refuses parts < 1. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py test_below_one_part_refused for n in 0, -1, -5
Magnitude-then-sign in allocate. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py test_negative_magnitude_then_sign asserts the SPECIFIC PARTS in order, because both candidate implementations sum correctly
apply_rate refuses float and negative rates, permits zero and above one. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py TestApplyRate, tests/money/test_uncovered_paths.py TestRateTypeRefusal
app/money/_rounding.py ROUNDING declared once. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py TestRoundingAtTheHalf: all five sampled halves, three of which diverge from banker's rounding
Exactly two rounding points: construction and apply_rate. No other operation quantizes. tests/money/test_arithmetic.py TestApplyRate
app/money/_ledger.py LedgerEntry.__post_init__ refuses a negative amount; app/money/_kinds.py records that the sign belongs to the kind. tests/money/test_ledger.py test_negative_amount_refused
app/money/_ledger.py derive() folds every quantity; DerivedQuantities holds no stored total
The identity asserted in all eight worked scenarios (tests/money/test_ledger.py assert_identity) and over 2000 randomized well-formed histories (tests/money/test_ledger_property.py)
app/money/_ledger.py _floor applied per cycle and to the total. tests/money/test_ledger.py TestPerCycleAndFloors
app/money/_ledger.py apply_credit computes min(available, owed), so over-application is unrepresentable rather than refused. tests/money/test_ledger.py test_scenario_s8_credit_exceeds_charge

app/money/_ledger.py carry_forward returns BOTH entries from one call; no one-sided path exists. tests/money/test_ledger.py test_produces_both_sides and test_scenario_s5_multi_period_carry (three periods, reads 3000 not 4000)
Credit attributed to the settling period, not the arrival period. tests/money/test_ledger.py test_scenario_s7_credit_applied_later
tests/money/test_ledger_property.py: Hypothesis over 2000 well-formed histories, generators derived from the kind enumeration, with hand-written per-kind expectations independent of IDENTITY_SIDE
app/money/wire.py to_wire: two decimals, no symbol, no separator, Latin digits. tests/money/test_wire.py TestEmit

app/money/wire.py parse rejects a JSON number loudly; android MoneySerializer inspects isString rather than .content. tests/money/test_wire.py test_json_number_rejected, MoneySerializerTest.fails loudly on a json number

app/money/wire.py is the single API chokepoint, documented as such with the argument against per-field serializers. The SQLAlchemy TypeDecorator is deferred with the persistence Bolt, which owns the first table
Locale formatting deferred out of B1 by human decision at this stage entry: the Bangla rendering is unspecified (OQ-B1-1). bolt-plan.md B1 DoD amended to match. Becomes blocking at B6.
The client never compares a money value. Needs a screen and a response schema; lands with the first UI-bearing Bolt.
Locale as an explicit argument. Deferred with BR5.4 since the operation it constrains is not built; the constraint is recorded in security-design A.6 so it binds whoever implements it.
app/money/wire.py to_wire refuses a negative; the canonical pattern admits no sign. tests/money/test_wire.py test_negative_refused, and MoneySerializerTest.fails on a signed string on the client side
tests/gates/test_import_gates.py TestGate1Outward: real-tree walk, violation fixture, and a configuration assertion that the walked path is a real non-empty package
pyproject.toml flake8-tidy-imports banned-api on decimal; tests/gates/test_import_gates.py TestGate2Inward runs the PROJECT'S ACTUAL Ruff config against a violating file and asserts non-zero exit
Both gates present from this first commit with their fixtures, not added after a violation. tests/gates/test_import_gates.py module docstring and the four fixture/config tests

android core/model/Money.kt is a @JvmInline value class over BigDecimal; NoFloatingPointTest.kt enforces the package-wide float ban as a backstop, verified by adding a toDouble() escape hatch and observing the failure

reverse.target: A layout correction with no upstream rule: the plan placed Kotlin under app/, which collides with the Python package of the same name — app/ would have held both app.money and an Android module whose conventional Gradle name is also app. Kotlin lives under android/ instead. The published package namespace com.shikkhokplus.app is UNCHANGED, being permanent once published [TC-2, D-38]

pyproject.toml exclude_also names assert_never by pattern. The one sanctioned unreachable line, justified by VERIFYING the stronger check: adding an eighth ledger kind without extending the fold fails mypy at exactly that line. Demonstrated, not asserted

Mis-siding a kind (treating a waiver as cash received) was caught by the worked scenario, NOT by mypy. Confirms the layering the design argued: static checks catch omission, hand-written expectations catch mis-siding, neither substitutes for the other

An earlier version of the property test asserted the identity over ARBITRARY entry sequences. Hypothesis shrank a counterexample to one entry — a receipt of 0.01 against no charge, giving -0.01 left and 0.00 right. The per-cycle floor is correct; the claim was too strong. The identity is a property of histories the system can produce, and the test now says so

tests/named_tests.toml plus tests/test_named_test_manifest.py: 30 entries, each naming its acceptance criterion and the rule it enforces, with a CI check that every entry resolves to a test that exists. Closes the gap coverage cannot see — a missing named test whose branches another test already covers

B1's DoD requires uv.lock and Gradle dependency locking with dependencyVerification checksums. Neither is generated here: uv is not installed in this environment, and both are Build and Test's scope. The CI workflow already assumes them. Recorded rather than silently omitted
